arStrings.szText: For a limited time, you can instantly boost one Eternal Character (or two Eternal Characters for Vessel of Hatred owners) to dive back in with ease, explore new class abilities, and rejoin the battle!
Travel to the Training Grounds in Kyovashad with the character of your choosing and interact with the Fated Reliquary inside to unlock the boost.
Pick from among three curated and ready to play builds and playstyles

Find your character at level 50, all Altars of Lilith unlocked, and be equipped with powerful legendaries and items. Explore Sanctuary, familiarize yourself with your newfound power, and prepare to face new challenges!
